title: Sagrada Família Golden Hour Tour …. TOTALLY WORTH IT
text: We had the Sagrada Família Basilica private tour with Xavi.  He was soooo knowledgeable and gave us a thorough history of the Basilica without being boring.  He was lively, engaging and very patient …. I take lots of pictures, he was so kind to indulge me.  The Basilica is GORGEOUS.  We picked the “Golden Hour” tour and it did not disappoint. The colors were spectacular, better than I ever imagined.
author: Grace_T
